subject: Error at the Occurrence density grid module (Component: Characteriza Environmental Space)

messages.author: 0632581e5c31ee1f
messages.subject: Error at the Occurrence density grid module (Component: Characteriza Environmental Space)
parts:
Hi everyone. I've been having some trouble at the Occurrence Density Grid module (ENV Space Component) and I don't really know what's going on. The package performs very well until it comes to that specific step, right after the PCA of the Environmental Ordinaton module. In RStudio I get the following error when I try to do the Occurrence Density Grid:  
Warning: Error in quantile.default: missing values and NaN's not allowed if 'na.rm' is FALSE 2: shiny::runApp 1: run_wallace
Does anyone know what could be the problem or the cause of this?
Thank you very much in advance.

messages.author: 881c0dd9c7b0d196
messages.subject: Re: Error at the Occurrence density grid module (Component: Characteriza Environmental Space)
parts:
Hi, 
Can you try updating your `ecospat` packages and update your `wallace` package to make sure you are running version 2.0.5 ?
I think this error is related to unmatched NA values in your environmental data, but try and see if updating those packages fixes it.
